notes.title: Update 4.0 - Code Rework + New Tutorial
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/52a7572e1b25e11be64d4056129bd1e911f0b943.png
Buckle up for Update 4.0!
Version number updates usually mean big changes incoming! There is a lot to note for this one.
Goose Goose Duck is turning 4 this year! Over the years, the team has been adding A LOT of content: 12 maps, 10 gamemodes, over 70 roles, and of course a TON of cosmetics to collect! Not only is that a lot of content but a lot of behind-the-scenes work as well, so it's good to go back once in a while and tidy things up a little to be able to keep adding content with as few hiccups as possible. In addition to the code rework, let's discuss some of the notable additions.

DISCLAIMER: With major code reworks, bugs and unintended features may turn up despite the amount of rigorous testing the amazing beta testers perform. If you experience a bug or unintended feature, please report them using the in-game bug report section found in Settings or fill out an online ticket form. 

TutorialThe tutorial section has been updated! We've improved the appearance as well as updated the Goose and Duck Tutorials to help explain how to play.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/e8fa617c41d02e896e13fd61c98ceea958d33637.png
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/d45012cf315b105da062245b0b93e5963e8c8fee.png"]

In-Game HUD
Updated the In-Game HUD visually; combining the role indicator with the duties list. The role indicator now acts as a button to quickly open information regarding your current role. With that additional space at the top of the screen, what should we do with it?

In-Game Notifications
For too long have notifications of all kinds had been placed in the same location, sometimes covering each other up. Now the Celebrity Death, Flight Points collected, Intercom Usage, Medium Ability, and Goose Hunt Death alerts appear at the top of the screen so that they don't interfere with each other and you can be well informed.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/e215a41bcfa78877e33c4645ccf190093e1d8328.png"]

Audio Input: Push to Mute
Similar to Push to Talk, Push to Mute is simply that - push to mute. An alternative to having to toggle the Mute key. It mutes your mic on press and unmutes on release.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/fe062f9cdf3293ae343c6e60979e785198d066f5.png

Pet of the Week Icon
The community talked, we listened. Now within the collections pet tab, we've added a calendar icon to indicate which pet is Pet of the Week.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/ba7bd1b11720657f1add480f7fd77bcf87c5c7f3.png

Bug Reports and Fixes
General Tickets
 Consistent Terminology:  Updated "No Microphone" in Quickplay filters to "Voice Chat".Role Tickets
 Invisibility Duck  Fixed: Vulnerable to being killed/swallowed while invisible. Fixed: Can't see corpses while invisible.  Looter Duck  Fixed: Disposing corpses in sinkholes reduces kill cooldown.  Mime Duck  Fixed: Ability movement with mouse is now easier to control.  Fixed: Movement is based off controlled player and not the Mime.  Ninja Duck  Fixed: Kill cooldown continues to go down during meetings.  Sniper Duck  Adjustment: Disabled on Nexus Colony.  Adjustment: Disabled on Ancient Sands.  Clown Duck  Fixed: Can't access vents.  Fixed: If target is cleansed in rejuvenation pod on Eagleton Springs, this is reflected to the Clown during meeting.  Party Duck  Fixed: If target is cleansed in rejuvenation pod on Eagleton Springs, this is reflected to the Party during meeting.  Hitman/Bodyguard  Fixed: Target revealed on opening splash screen.  Fixed: Dueling Dodos can't be VIP target.  Lovers  Adjustment: When assassinated in a meeting, shots are delayed rather than simultaneous.  Astral Goose  Fixed: No longer able to interact with objects (tasks, rollercoaster, etc.) while in astral form.  Avenger Goose  Fixed: Ability no longer activates through forbidden passageways.  Canadian Goose  Fixed: If corpse is consumed before auto-report triggers, no meeting is called.  Gravy Goose  Fixed: Gravy Reward is rewarded at end of match.  Fixed: If Sheriff attacks Gravy, and Gravy deflects to a duck/neutral, Sheriff does not die.  Mortician Goose  Fixed: Returned to available roles.  Stalker Goose  Fixed: If target is swallowed by Pelican and is later released, arrow returns to original target.  Dueling Dodo  Fixed: If other Dodo dies before unlocking the kill cooldown, when tasks are completed, the countdown will continue and disappear on zero.  Vulture  Fixed: Vulture is able to eat feet/corpses created by Demolitionist. Map Tickets
 Ancient Sands  Fixed: Cursed Bell Sabotage resets properly.  Bloodhaven  Fixed: Cursed Bell Sabotage resets properly.  Black Swan  Removed: Communication Sabotage.  Carnival  Added: Mimic added to available roles.  Fixed: Rabbit wins with the Ducks if it survives the Rabbit Sabotage.  Godzilla  Added: Mimic added to available roles.  Nexus Colony  Removed: Communication Sabotage.  Fixed: Loading Dock can be lethal. 
That's going to do it for this update note. Remember, if you come across any bugs or unintended features, please report them using the in-game bug report feature in Settings or fill out the online ticket form.

notes.title: v3.10 Scientist & Draft Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/5f56e3c4a60352959ed75e041af8ac47b2ece0e8.png
New Role: Scientist

 You can scan for dead bodies. The ability recharges when inactive.
 The Scientist Goose has the ability to activate a Scan ability to search for bodies. Once the Scan ability is activated, a beeping sound will begin along with a visual indicator above your goose’s head, increasing in speed in closer proximity to an avian carcass. Once the time of activation reaches zero or is deactivated, the timer of the Scan ability will recharge in 1 second intervals, and cannot be reactivated until it has 15 charges.
 Exclusive to the Carnival.

Game Updates: Draft Mode!
Draft Settings have been incorporated!

 You can now select which roles will appear in the drafting pool for Draft Mode.
 Up to 8 selected roles can be turned off for Draft Mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/5a7f129420457f7186679c6b71cc879158840f34.png

 Game Information Panel shows Unavailable Roles and Available Roles in Lobby.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/9df38aa41565c0d94130c7e3f68a0d7e347673e5.png

 When Pelican eats another player that was given a bomb, the bomb ticking sound can now be heard.
 Goosechapel and Mallard Manor sabotages available correctly after reconnecting when Duck player disconnects.
 Tastes Like Chicken - Camo Players: When downed and picked up by Chicken, players are no longer showing as invisible. 
 The Carnival - Roller Coaster Sabotage: Players riding the Roller Coaster when the Roller Coaster Sabotage is called will no longer survive. 

Optimizations: Better Performance across multiple devices. 

 Lowered texture and audio memory across the game.

In The Works: Eagleton Springs

Drone Role:

Unlock sabotage using the "Honk IT", sabotages in Eagleton Springs work slightly differently than other maps. By activating a sabotage, 

 Doors - intermittently closes random doors

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/c2a194bd92c89278ad3cbed590261be97159f849.png
Pelican is going to be added to all Maps!
What about the Falcon? Falcon is going to be added to all maps!
How does that work?
If a falcon is selected, there can be no Pelican.
If a pelican is selected, there can be no Falcon nor Vulture!
If a vulture is selected, there can be no Pelican.

Fine, Lovers and Hitman/Bodyguard can be added to draft.
How does that work?
Only one set of paired roles can be selected (if there are lovers, no hitman/bodyguard and vice versa)
Once the first lover/hitman/bodyguard is selected, they will appear as ? in the draft. Later in the draft players will be presented to be the other half of the pair. If no one selects the other half, it is forced upon the last player in the draft.

notes.title: Update 2.26
notes.notes:
New Game Mode: Tastes Like Chicken
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/7268b7cc0d915584fab3f9e8cd376f7103bd4a8a.png
Tastes Like Chicken is a Social Deduction Battle Royale. Protect your team's chicken and kill everyone else. The last team standing wins!

Choose Your Role
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/f63ec1674f43d3e57aca8d2f09a4224dbb199668.gif
Teammates take turns selecting their roles. Teams consist of one chicken accompanied by ducks.
Options include:

 Chicken - You can finish off enemy downed players or resurrect your team.
 Camo Duck - Invisible to other teams from a certain distance.
 Identity Thief - You shapeshift into your most recent victim.
 Undertaker - Dragged downed enemy players.
 Bodyguard - Blocks attacks for teammates.

Eliminate the other team while protecting yours
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/101c436cefdd7f00358f7692ac6f7db4ddaff41f.gif
Ducks time their strikes to down enemy players. When a player is downed, they are in a vulnerable state to be finished off by an opposing chicken! They will need to be revived by their chicken before it is too late!

Note: Tastes Like Chicken is available on all maps EXCLUDING Nexus Colony.
Why not Nexus Colony? Having two separated sections of the map with an enclosing space and limited transportation between the two would prove this game mode difficult/unfun compared to the other maps and we want players to have fun!

UI Updates Pt. 1
To begin our UI updates we focused on easing lobby creation and sharing GGD News.
Including map descriptions and details.

New Game Mode: Corruption
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318739/6bd74d483a5feead3cc03ba921690042de57eab9.png
An advanced variant of the Classic game mode recommended only for experienced players. This introduces the corruption mechanic as well as several new roles.

This means the Corruption mechanic (and the roles associated with it) have been removed from Bloodhaven in Classic game mode and has been added to its own game mode: Corruption!

This gives players the option to enjoy Bloodhaven with or without the corruption mechanic. 
This also opens up the potential to add the Corruption game mode to other existing maps as well as new maps in the future while still being able to provide the Classic game mode experience to players.

notes.title: 10/01/2023 Update
notes.notes:
Our success has been incredible, and I want to thank all our players once again. We underwent a massive attack this morning and subsequently took our servers down to maintain and reinforce them. None of your data was compromised.

We’ve been undergoing attacks for approximately two months now. We’ve mentioned it once mid-December, but we made a decision to avoid mentioning it further so as to not alarm players. The combination of the attack and our high player numbers (600 thousand CCU’s) left us vulnerable.
We have hired very talented cybersecurity specialists to help us. We don’t want to say much beyond this, because we don’t want to expose specific ways in which we are trying to safeguard ourselves. 
Our plan is to come back on Wednesday at 5 PM EST. We want to do the best that we can to secure as much as possible, instead of rushing back tonight. We will keep everyone posted if anything changes.

I want to thank all our players for their patience and understanding during this time. We are doing everything that we can. We are very grateful for our community’s support.

notes.title: UPDATE 2.0
notes.notes:
- Big server upgrades 
- New Daily Reward system
- New EXP system
- New Player Banners and Cards
- New achievements
- Server optimizations and various bug fixes

We went into more detail in DevLog Update Stream 3 (which can be found here: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1477068925) but this update is a big change, so we thank everyone for their patience. The game was effectively rebuilt from the ground up over the course of a month and a half. Some of the practical differences to players will be: 

- Latency will almost be effectively halved for everyone. 
- Many bug fixes and game balancing updates can be done without needing to update the client.
- Security will be increased for everyone. 
- Sets the stage for other updates like opening proximity chat to public games, controller support, etc.

In DevLog 3, we also covered our upcoming basement map. You can find the trailer here:
[previewyoutube=GDC3jq8Z1y4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: v1.06 Lounge and Spectator Mode release!
notes.notes:
A big update with more things to come soon!

The Lounge. A new place to make friends, chat and hang out. It has private rooms and a card game currently, and we plan on having more activities in it like minigames and karaoke in the future. The host of a public lounge can migrate the lobby to a private game. 

Spectator mode. The long awaited spectator mode! You can now join games in progress as a spectator. You'll also be able to switch to spectator mode in a lobby, as well as after you die in game. Note that Geese will have to finish their tasks to spectate.

Celebrity Goose.  A goose that lets other geese know when they die. Ducks and Neutrals will not be alerted.

Various QoL and Bug fixes

notes.title: V0.99.7 MINOR UPDATE Mallard Manor and the Falcon
notes.notes:
We know how hotly anticipated the mobile release is, but we thought we'd give this minor update during the wait
- New Mallard Manor map: New tasks, 6 new death stingers, new music, and more! There are no vents in Mallard Manor and the Mechanic has been replaced with the snoop goose, who can hide in closets
- Introduction of the Falcon. The Falcon is a neutral role that wins if he's last one alive. He can kill, and can only skip in meetings. If the Falcon is alive in the final 3, a countdown begins where other players will have an opportunity to hunt down the Falcon before they win.
- Completed tasks are now automatically removed from your task list to reduce screen clutter
- Player volumes are now represented by a green bar, so you can tell who is speaking in real-time and adjust their volumes accordingly
- In SS Mother Goose, the vent in security has been moved over to medical for balance reasons. If you have any complaints, send them to our community moderator Xizta
- Due to complaints about the Birdwatcher, we have "improved" default vision to be a normal goose's vision. His ability to see through walls is now an activatable ability.
- Pigeon cooldown is now adaptive based on the number of players in the game. The fewer players, the longer the pigeon cooldown
- Bug fixes
- Optimizations

notes.title: Version 0.93 Early Access
notes.notes:
Role Changes:
Engineer is now named mechanic because people were calling it that anyway. It also has a round start cooldown to use vents and also has a cooldown when they exit the vents preventing them from spamming the vents.

Mechanic is now named Technician.

New Role: Sheriff – can kill as many times as they want but will commit suicide if they kill a goose.
Roles can now be selected as “maybe”, giving them a 50/50 chance of being in the game.

All special roles can be selected as “maybe” in the game. This will be denoted with a question mark and will imply a 50/50 chance of being in the next game.

Role screens now give detailed information on the role, game mode, and objective. 

At the beginning of the round you’ll see all players if you’re a goose, you will also see other ducks if you’re a duck and blind ducks are not on.

Features:
Soap and 2x spicy ramen packages have been added to the kitchen.

Quickplay now creates a room if none are available in your region.

Mini-map now available in voting panel and displays where you were last on the ship.

Colorblind mode enabled on Door Calibration task, and both wires tasks. Vaccine will receive support later. 

Input boxes now support Korean, Japanese, Russian, Greek, Chinese (simp), and Chinese (Trad), and other variants. 

Tasks have been made to open/close faster.

Some tasks have been made slightly easier.

Pond shower collider has been made easier to move around but the duck can move faster in Goose Hunt Mode.

Press “P” to deafen all voice chat. 

Player volumes can now be individually controlled and also have cosmetics showing on the player list.

Kicking a player from a lobby, bans them from that lobby until otherwise forgiven. 

Mini-map is now available during voting sessions and will display your last known location.

Vote card speaker indicator is now brighter. 

Ducks will see one another’s names as red during voting if blind ducks is not enabled.

Craft-able items now display how many more items you need to find.

Fullscreen toggle is now in the game.

WASD + Mouse Movement toggles allow for both, one or the other to be enabled. 

Chat Sysbot now offers more information about starting and ending games.

Comms sabotage now prevents emergency meetings from being called but arrows show up guiding players where to go fix it.

If you’re done your tasks as a ghost you cannot be kicked for being AFK.

Fixes:
Killing and eating will no longer require moving in and out of range of other players. It will happen based on target distance and update automatically. 

Ultrawide monitors now display better.

Comms sabotage

You can no longer kill someone as they enter a vent or report bodies through doors/walls.
